_note: LLD §5.4. Recipients: principal, coordinators, reporter_parent, next_level_up, finance_all, self. Nobody is ever sent a report they could not see; restricted reports therefore reach only the principal and coordinators. The weekly digest goes to the principal on Monday 09:00; its need-versus-spend part only to finance scope all.

rules.description: Restricted category: principal and coordinators only, text only
Urgent report filed: at once, with the first photo
Normal report: one message to the reporter's parent, no escalation
Auto-filed with no category: coordinators sort it
Urgent and not acknowledged after 30 minutes
Urgent and not acknowledged after 60 minutes; then marked escalated
Daily digest; the finance part only to finance scope all
Weekly digest, Monday 09:00; top five need-versus-spend areas only to finance scope all
Positive balance and no expense for 5 days; at most once per 5 days
